DICETHESPIRE-THE_INVENTOR.aromaPrinciple: [sine][orange]If it can be built...it can be destroyed...[/orange][/sine]
DICETHESPIRE-THE_INVENTOR.banter.alive.e: I bet the car weighs down the wheel!
It is very common for Slimes to collect debris as they slide along the ground.
That's why it is recommended to keep Slimes inside of Ice Cream cones.
But don't try to eat the slime ice cream, it'll still melt your skin.
Interesting that being shrunk down by the beatle doesn't have any health complications.
Most bodies don't function properly when scaled down, having ill health effects.
I'd expect us shrinking to result in us having about 25% less HP, but it seems to be fine.
The fuzzy worm reminds me of one time as a kid I was playing in my backyard...
and I started collecting bugs in a jar. It's a shame I forgot to put the lid on it before I went inside.
Interesting to see there are also cubic robots here!
I wonder if they also have to deal with errors from too much CPU?
That ink goes from slippery to grippy in just a few scratches, I bet you could make good electrical gloves from that.
These slugs seem to have the ability to absorb the strength of creatures they eat...
...better keeep them away from Warrior.
If I could figure out how to tame those Sea Punks, I'd have so many spare hands when building!
First time seeing a spikey frog, usually that's the job of a rose or a cactus.
Thank god this hoard of rats only bite, I don't want to get poisoned again.
New set, same gimmick. Birds yell Caw, and suddenly I'm in a ton of pain.
I'd love to dissect one of those Exoskeletons. They have somehow mastered armor that only protects from big hits.
This giant red bug's goop makes it so difficult to move, but it also leaves the skin incredibly soft...
...under no circumstances can I let Witch near this thing.
Needing to fight multiple enemies at once really changes how you approach combat.
